name: Massed Armour
description: Advance on a broad front and trade fire. Ground is taken by weight of steel, not by cleverness; scouts are a luxury when the whole battalion is the reconnaissance.

name: Elastic Defence
description: Cede ground, keep the guns alive, and make every hex cost something. Fights from cover and high ground, and would rather shell an advance than meet it.

name: Reconnaissance Pull
description: Lead with fast, cheap eyes and commit the weight only where they find a way through. Spreads out, and dislikes advancing into ground nobody has looked at.

name: Bounding Overwatch
description: Move one element while another watches the ground it is crossing, and take the next bound only once the last one is covered. Advances to contact rather than through it: it will halt and fight what shoots at it, which is what the overwatch is for. Keeps its sections in sight of one another, wants height and cover to watch from, and does not like open roads.

name: Battle Drill
description: Not a way of fighting a battle but a way of surviving a moment: what a crew does under fire when nobody has told her anything. Return fire, seek cover, stay near friends, and want nothing else on the map — no objectives, no exits, no advancing to contact. The engine consults this posture for unordered units in danger; a mod that removes it gets a built-in equivalent.

name: Delaying Action
description: Trade ground for time. Hold what you are given, make the enemy pay to come on, and break off before the price is your company rather than after.
